decisive_items: using serial doses of nonionic iodinated contrast (Iopromide) totaling 3 mL/kg over 30 minutes
approximately 12 hours after the procedure, the patient developed clonic movements of the left upper limb and persistent sucking motions
slight diffuse increase in cortical density predominantly in the right frontal, parietal, and occipital lobes
response.rationale: Temporal link to contrast exposure, focal seizures, and cortical hyperdensity without hemorrhage favor contrast-induced encephalopathy over hypoxic-ischemic injury, which would show different timing and imaging pattern.

rejected.why: Cardiorespiratory arrest and low saturation are present, but the delayed focal seizures and cortical hyperdensity after contrast administration are more specific to contrast-induced encephalopathy.
